drawCalls.target: complex entry/gallery <=120 at the matched preset/camera

shaderPrograms.target: no additional shader program on the first visible frames after preparation

integratedGPU100ms.target: no frame >100ms in the first3seconds on a validated integrated GPU
integratedGPU100ms.status: not-verified: physical integrated GPU unavailable; software renderer exceeds100ms in all observed runs

tests.command: vitest run roadmap-stage2-rendering rendering-corrections operator-art static-geometry peeking-geometry mechanics-maps

limits: Counts are actual WebGL submissions and submitted triangles, not FPS or GPU-time claims.
The broader exact-palette batch raises complex entry submitted triangles by996, while reducing calls. Collision meshes, spawns, sightlines and character/weapon geometry are unchanged.

Startup rAF callback-arrival intervals are observational on shared software rendering. Original and two sequential pairs are retained; no cherry-picked FPS improvement or physical input-to-photon result is claimed.
Original appearance comparisons are screenshots from the matched actual renderer fixture, not generated art.
